lines.beaver: 여보세요? 지수야, 토요일에 만나는 거 맞지?
lines.beaver_en: Hello? Jisu, we're still meeting Saturday, right?
lines.beaver_roman: yeoboseyo? jisuya, toyoire mannaneun geo matji?
lines.learner: 민지야, 미안해. 그 약속 때문에 전화했어.
lines.en: Minji, sorry. I called because of that plan.
lines.roman: minjiya, mianhae. geu yaksok ttaemune jeonhwahaesseo.

lines.en: I totally forgot I already have plans Saturday.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, really? Then should we cancel?
lines.en: No, I'd rather postpone than cancel.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. What about the restaurant reservation?
lines.en: I'll change the reservation. Don't worry.
How about meeting Sunday for lunch?

lines.beaver: 일요일 좋아. 그날 다른 일정은 없어?
lines.beaver_en: Sunday's good. Nothing else planned that day?
lines.beaver_roman: iryoil joa. geunal dareun iljeongeun eopseo?
lines.learner: 응, 할머니 댁은 다음 주에 가기로 했어.
lines.en: Yeah, I decided to visit Grandma next week.
lines.roman: eung, halmeoni daegeun daeum jue gagiro haesseo.

lines.beaver: 알겠어. 이번엔 약속 어기면 안 돼!
lines.beaver_en: Got it. Don't break the promise this time!
lines.beaver_roman: algesseo. ibeonen yaksok eogimyeon an dwae!
lines.en: Okay, I definitely won't break it this time.

lines.beaver_en: Won't that place be noisy on the weekend?
lines.en: Sunday lunch should be quiet. It'll be fine.

lines.beaver_en: It's really been ages since we've seen each other.
lines.en: Right. I'm really looking forward to meeting.

lines.beaver_en: Then see you Sunday at twelve!
lines.learner: 응, 바꿔 줘서 고마워. 일요일에 봐!
lines.en: Okay, thanks for changing it. See you Sunday!
lines.roman: eung, bakkwo jwoseo gomawo. iryoire bwa!
